name: info-hint
title: Info Hint
description: A small muted info button beside a heading or label that opens a popover with one sentence of explanation and an optional link that opens in a new tab.

meta.whenToUse: One sentence that explains a heading, label or setting on demand — on click, tap or keyboard — with an optional link to the full help article.
meta.whenNotToUse: Naming an icon-only control (Tooltip), text people must read to complete a task (FieldDescription or inline copy), or rich content and actions (Popover or HoverCard).
